title: A Wooded Retreat
description:
Welcome to this cozy apartment, only minutes to downtown Nashville and BNA airport. Apartment is on the lower level of our single family home that offers a private entrance deck, and plenty of parking.  Gathering room with fireplace is open to the fully equipped kitchen, and eat at island. Fast wifi, 42” TV in Gathering room. Bath has panoramic mirror and custom ceramic shower. Apt. has it's own laundry .  A wooded retreat that is close by to Nashville for a getaway!

The space
Bedroom cove ( no door) has one 1 Queen bed
Gathering room has fold out Futon sleeps two

No part of the apartment is shared during your stay for your complete privacy. 

Gathering room has a 42” tv with cable
 
Kitchen is fully stocked with coffee maker, toaster, pots, pans, plates, cups, utensils etc everything you would need for cooking & eating

Guest access
Self check-in with lock code at entry

Other things to note
Steep  50' walk to private entrance
